about_the_game:
Ready to put your brain to the ultimate test? Brain Test All-Star: IQ Boost brings the beloved puzzle series to Steam with hundreds of clever and surprising riddles that force you to think outside the box. Solve puzzles, outsmart tricky mechanics, and showcase your brainpower in a fun and addictive puzzle adventure!

This newest entry in the long-running Brain Test franchise introduces an all-new IQ scoring system that tracks your progress, measures your improvement, and lets you challenge yourself and others on Steam. With over 1000 original puzzles, new modes, and daily challenges, this is the most complete Brain Test experience ever created.

Revisit your favorite Brain Test characters—Agent Smith, Monster Hunter Joe, Uncle Bubba, Doctor Worry, and Tom the Cat—as they return with new and even trickier puzzle adventures. Whether you’re a newcomer or a veteran player of Brain Test 1, 2, 3, and 4, IQ Boost offers something for everyone: from relaxing casual riddles to hardcore brain-busting challenges.

And the best part? Brain Test All-Star: IQ Boost is completely free of hidden fees—play offline, on the go, or relax at home. It’s brain training made fun, accessible, and rewarding.

Features:
• Over 1000 tricky and original brain teaser puzzles.
• Extensive IQ scoring system that tracks your development.
• Hard challenge levels designed for veteran players.
• Daily puzzles with special rewards for active players.
• Frequent updates that add new puzzles and levels.
• Free brain training with fun and mindfulness benefits.
• Stress-free gameplay with intuitive hint and skip systems.
• Fluid animations, colorful graphics, and immersive sound.
• Play offline, no Wi-Fi required.
• One-hand gameplay for maximum convenience.
• Completely free to play, no hidden costs.

Demo Version Information
The Steam demo allows players to experience the Brain Test fun with a limited set of features:
• Includes 50 main levels to play.
• Master levels, daily puzzles, and weekend rumble stages are not available in the demo.
• All other core mechanics of the game are fully accessible.

Are you ready to boost your IQ and prove your brainpower on Steam?
